title: How Objects Move
seo_title: Foundation Science: How Objects Move Worksheets (Australian Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe how objects move and how factors including their size, shape or material influence their movement (Australian Curriculum v9.0 Science content description).
meta_desc: Free Foundation science worksheets on how objects move: rolling, sliding, bouncing and spinning, pushes and pulls, and how shape, size, material and surfaces change movement. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Round things roll. Flat things slide.
key_sub: A push or pull makes things move. Shape, size and material change how they move.
body_html:
How to think about it

Things move in different ways.

  • Balls roll. Boxes slide.
  • Rubber balls bounce. Tops spin.
  • A push or a pull makes things move.
Example

Which rolls: a ball or a book?

a ball is round

Answer: a ball

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a cube can roll like a ball.
  • Thinking things move without a push or pull.

faq.a: A push or a pull. Gravity also pulls things down when they fall.

faq.q: Why do some things roll and others slide?
faq.a: Round things roll. Things with flat sides slide.

faq.q: How can children explore movement at home?
faq.a: Roll different balls down a ramp, slide toys on different floors and see which ones bounce.
